---
title: "India Foreign Policy"
description: "India's neighbourhood policy, the Quad, great power dynamics, and strategic autonomy"
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
---

India's foreign policy operates at the intersection of strategic autonomy, neighbourhood management, and great power alignment. I write on India's relations with China, Pakistan, and the countries of the Indian subcontinent, the Quad and Indo-Pacific strategy, and how domestic political economy shapes foreign policy choices.

::: {.topic-hero}
::: {.topic-hero-card}
### Newsletter

The *Matsyanyaaya* section of [Anticipating the Unintended](../newsletter.html) covers India's foreign policy and geopolitics every week.
:::

::: {.topic-hero-card}
### Book

[*Missing in Action*](../books.html) (Penguin India, 2023) includes chapters on India's foreign policy frameworks and how to think about national interest.
:::

:::

## Related Ideas & Notes

::: {.idea-card}
### Indian state governments should permanent trade and investment desks in important business centres of the world
States understand their own comparative advantages, needs, and challenges far better than the union government — economic paradiplomacy lets them act on that directly. [Read more →](../big-ideas.html)
:::

::: {.field-note-card}
Biden administration overestimated America's narrative power and Trump administration is overestimating America's coercive power. Don't underestimate the agency of nation-states. They will find smart ways to bypass coercion and restrictions.

[More Field Notes →](../field-notes/index.html#observations)
:::
